format: segments: {<party.segment>: {label (Russian chip text), party: default {adults, children} when the brief has no counts, prefs: default prefs (source default, shown as chips), district_weights: {lively, quiet, family, walkable} weights for ranking hotels by OSM district scores (sum 1), jev_criteria: English criteria text for Jev segment routing}}. Segments not listed (other) use neutral weights 0.25 each.

solo.label: один
solo.jev_criteria: One adult travelling alone, no partner, children or friends mentioned.

couple.label: вдвоём
couple.jev_criteria: Two adults travelling together (partner, spouse, 'вдвоём'), no children.

family.label: с детьми
family.jev_criteria: Adults travelling with one or more children (ребёнок, дети, сын, дочь).

friends.label: компанией
friends.jev_criteria: A group of three or more adult friends or colleagues, no children.
